# dictionary form, form name (the first five only find the row), meaning, why. The meaning
# says what this form means in the dialogue, for example noi: those (at most 60 characters).
# The why is one line of at most 140 characters that says why the form looks like this, names
# no grammar term other than the ones in the form name and holds no memory trick. An empty
# cell is an empty entry still to write.
